logoNote: Marks are career context for organizations and technologies already named on the site. They are not endorsements, partnerships, or a sponsor wall. Dale Carnegie has no logo here because an official file could not be fetched. Technology marks are the public brand shapes for tools named in the experience record: Simple Icons 16.37.0 (CC0) and the Azure mark from Wikimedia Commons (public domain). Added marks use Simple Icons 16.37.0 (CC0), the AWS architecture icons redistributed by awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml, the Dale Carnegie wordmark from dalecarnegie.com, the NetSeg logo from netseg.com.br, and the USJ logotype from the university site as archived on 7 Mar 2016 (the USJ portion only).
